BL-808 — swarm_handoff.bb's backlog depth warning counts directory entries, not tickets — the tracked .gitkeep reads as an active ticket on every handoff
What it solves: Found alongside BL-807 in the same coordinator hand-off batch; both are
swarm-reliability health-signal defects and both were confirmed by probe
rather than inference. They are independent — different files, different
mechanisms, no shared code — so no `depends_on` between them, and they can
run in…
Approval context: Routine defect, one line of cause; flagging only because the fix location is a judgement call and I have ruled on it rather than asking.
R1 puts the shared counter in `backlog_depth_lib.bb` rather than inlining a `.yaml` filter at the call site. That lib exists precisely because these two call site…
BL-808 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-808" (or "reject BL-808 <reason>") to act.
